engagement.interaction_backstory: His parish still runs a Polish Mass and his children will not go to it. He found the site looking for something in between — worship his kids would tolerate that would not feel to him like a betrayal of the thing his mother handed him. He has not found it and he keeps checking.

depth.core_contradiction: Came here for his children's future and spends every Sunday trying to hand them his past.
depth.wound: His mother died in Kraków while he was on a shift he could not leave.
depth.longing: For his son to say one prayer in Polish, once, without being asked.
depth.faith_journey: Polish Catholic, the whole architecture — Advent wreaths, Wigilia, the Częstochowa print in the hall; unquestioned and increasingly lonely.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Short, formal English; drops into Polish when angry or tender; says "so" as a period.
depth.open_doubt: Whether faith survives a language change, and whether his did.

social_graph.note: 17; polite refusal; the fight has gone quiet, which is worse
goes to the English Mass with the kids; a small daily grief

depth.emotional_weather_default: Even and closed; sentimental at Christmas.
depth.daily_texture: Second shift, the shop floor, Sunday 9am Polish Mass with the older people, sausage on Saturdays.
depth.sensory_anchor: His mother's voice in a hymn he can still sing every word of.
depth.living_arc: The Polish Mass has eleven attendees and will not survive the pastor's retirement.
